rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone is extremely angry.

example.english: They were really irate after hearing about this.
example.traditional: 佢聽完呢單嘢真係好嬲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teng1 jyun4 ne1 daan1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 nau1

rows.note: Use this for especially strong emphasis, meaning furious or angry to an extreme degree.

example.english: The customer was irate and said they would definitely complain.
example.traditional: 個客嬲到爆，話一定要投訴。
example.jyutping: go3 haak3 nau1 dou3 baau3 waa6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tau4 sou3

rows.note: Use this vivid idiom when the person's anger is visibly flaring up, rather than as a neutral description.

example.english: The manager was irate when he saw that the goods were not up to standard.
example.traditional: 經理見到貨不對辦，火都嚟埋。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 gin3 dou2 fo3 bat1 deoi3 baan2 fo2 dou1 lai4 maai4
